dict.string: ReEnchanted can read your calendar so the Book knows when the day has a hinge coming. Events never leave your phone.
ReEnchanted can read your calendar so the Book knows when the day has a hinge coming. Events never leave your phone.
ReEnchanted uses the microphone only when you tap a voice input button, so you can speak notes, answers, and page text into the Book.
ReEnchanted can set a Reminder when you ask it to — like a Fae bargain's deadline — so the world can gently reach you outside the app.
ReEnchanted uses speech recognition only when you tap a voice input button, turning your spoken words into local page text.
